title: Public `poke()` Allows Permissionless Interest-Rate Parameter Manipulation
vuln_type: Logic / State Machine Flaw → Economic Manipulation
impact: `DAIInterestRateModelV3.poke()` is `public` with no access control. It recomputes `baseRatePerBlock` and `multiplierPerBlock` from live Maker `pot.dsr()` and `jug` values. While it reads on-chain state (so values are "real"), the function is a **state-changing write** callable by anyone at any time, and the derived values feed directly into `getBorrowRate` → `accrueInterest`. An attacker who can influence Maker governance-adjacent parameters (or simply time calls around DSR/stability-fee changes) can force rate recomputation at inopportune blocks. More importantly, `updateJumpRateModel` writes `gapPerBlock` **before** calling `updateJumpRateModelInternal` and `poke()` — if `poke()` reverts or if `kink` is set to 0 by a malicious owner, `multiplierPerBlock = gapPerBlock * BASE / kink` divides by zero and permanently bricks interest accrual for the cDAI market (all mints/borrows/redeems that call `accrueInterest` revert).
